game.name: Grid 2 (Europe)(Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: Be fast, be the best and be famous with the return of GRID 2, the sequel to Race Driver: GRID. Experience aggressive racing against advanced AI and immerse yourself in the race thanks to GRID 2's new TrueFeel handling system, which offers an exceptional sensation behind the wheel of each legendary vehicle. The next-generation "EGO" engine delivers incredible graphics and never-before-seen damage in races set on three continents, where you'll have to prove yourself in an ever-changing world of motorsport. Gain fame and riches by winning in intense, fast-paced races on real circuits, on faithfully reproduced streets and on mountainous roads with highly dangerous hairpins.
